grammar: 介词，表示“在……上”；用法较正式，常见于故事或书面语。
collocations: upon the table；once upon a time
commonMistake: 日常表达“在……上”更常用 on；upon 常见于固定或较正式的表达。

example.english: The bird landed upon a low branch.
example.chinese: 那只鸟落在一根低矮的树枝上。

application.prompt: The king put the book on top of the table, not below it. The book is ___ the table. (upon / under)
application.solution: upon。解析：upon 表示“在……上”，与句意相符。

grammar: 固定表达，常用于童话或故事开头，表示“从前、很久以前”。
collocations: Once upon a time, ...；a story begins with once upon a time
commonMistake: 这是完整的固定表达，不能漏掉 once 或 upon。

example.english: Once upon a time, a little duckling lived by a lake.
example.chinese: 从前，有一只小鸭子住在湖边。

application.prompt: Choose the usual opening for a fairy tale: (Once upon a time / In the end)
application.solution: Once upon a time。解析：童话故事常以 Once upon a time 开头。

sources.label: Cambridge Dictionary: once upon a time

grammar: 动词，表示咬、咬伤；过去式 bit，过去分词 bitten。
collocations: bite an apple；bite someone；a dog bite
commonMistake: bite 的过去式是 bit，过去分词是 bitten；不要把它们混淆。

example.english: The dog bit the stick and carried it away.
example.chinese: 狗咬住木棍，把它叼走了。

application.prompt: Yesterday the dog ___ the toy. (bit / bited)
application.solution: bit。解析：bite 的过去式是 bit。

grammar: 短语动词，表示“咬穿”；through 后接被咬穿的物体。
collocations: bite through a rope；bite through the bag
commonMistake: bite through 后直接接被咬穿的物体，不加 at。

example.english: A mouse bit through the paper bag.
example.chinese: 一只老鼠咬穿了纸袋。

application.prompt: The mouse made a hole in the bag with its teeth. It ___ the bag. (bit through / bit at)
application.solution: bit through。解析：咬穿某物用 bite through。

grammar: 可数名词，表示网或网状物；复数为 nets。
collocations: a fishing net；a net for catching fish；mend a net
commonMistake: net 是可数名词，单数前通常需要 a、the 等限定词。

example.english: The fisherman repaired his net beside the lake.
example.chinese: 渔夫在湖边修补他的网。

application.prompt: The fisherman uses a ___ to catch fish. (net / feather)
application.solution: net。解析：用来捕鱼的网是 net。

grammar: 可数名词，表示猎人、搜寻者；由 hunt 加后缀 -er 构成。
collocations: a hunter in the forest；a skilled hunter
commonMistake: hunter 指猎人或搜寻者；表示“打猎”这一动作应使用 hunt。

example.english: The hunter walked quietly through the forest.
example.chinese: 猎人悄悄地穿过森林。

application.prompt: A person who hunts animals is a ___. (hunter / duckling)
application.solution: hunter。解析：猎人是 hunter。

grammar: 可作动词或名词，表示承诺、诺言；常用 promise to do sth 或 make a promise。
collocations: promise to help；keep a promise；make a promise
commonMistake: promise 作动词后可接 to do；名词 promise 常与 make、keep、break 搭配。

example.english: The girl promised to bring the net back.
example.chinese: 女孩答应把网拿回来。

application.prompt: He said he would help and made a ___. (promise / war)
application.solution: promise。解析：make a promise 表示许下承诺。

grammar: 副词短语，表示“很久以前”；常用于叙述过去的故事。
collocations: a long time ago；long ago
commonMistake: long ago 指过去很久以前；表达具体的“……以前”常说 three years ago。

example.english: Long ago, a wise king lived near the sea.
example.chinese: 很久以前，一位明智的国王住在海边。

application.prompt: A story begins with “A very long time ___, ...” (ago / later)
application.solution: ago。解析：表示“很久以前”用 long ago。

examTags: 语法·可数名词与不可数名词
grammar: 名词，表示战争；泛指战争时常作不可数名词，具体的一场战争可作可数名词。
collocations: be at war；a long war；during the war
commonMistake: 表示战争状态常用 at war；谈论某一场战争时可说 a war 或 the war。

example.english: The story takes place during a war.
example.chinese: 这个故事发生在一场战争期间。

application.prompt: The two countries were fighting for years. They were at ___. (war / peace)
application.solution: war。解析：处于战争状态可说 be at war。

grammar: 可数名词，表示邻居；英式拼写 neighbour，美式拼写 neighbor。
collocations: next-door neighbour；a friendly neighbour；talk to a neighbour
commonMistake: neighbour 是英式拼写；neighbor 是美式拼写，含义相同。

example.english: Our neighbour brought us a basket of apples.
example.chinese: 我们的邻居给我们送来一篮苹果。

application.prompt: Choose the British spelling from the word list: (neighbour / neighbor)
application.solution: neighbour。解析：本词条采用英式拼写 neighbour。

grammar: 形容词，表示明智的、高明的；常放在名词前或 be 动词后。
collocations: a wise king；a wise choice；be wise to do sth
commonMistake: wise 是形容词；修饰动词时需用 wisely。

example.english: The wise king listened to both sides of the story.
example.chinese: 明智的国王听取了故事双方的说法。

application.prompt: A person who makes good choices is ___. (wise / truth)
application.solution: wise。解析：形容词 wise 表示明智的。

grammar: 可数名词，表示皇帝；复数为 emperors。
collocations: the emperor；an ancient emperor；the emperor's palace
commonMistake: emperor 是可数名词；表示特指的皇帝时常用 the emperor。

example.english: The emperor asked the official to tell the truth.
example.chinese: 皇帝让官员说出真相。

application.prompt: The ruler of an empire is an ___. (emperor / artist)
application.solution: emperor。解析：帝国的统治者是 emperor。

grammar: 按课本义作动词表示撒谎，过去式和过去分词为 lied；作名词表示谎言。
collocations: tell a lie；lie to someone；tell the truth
commonMistake: 表示“撒谎”时 lie 的过去式是 lied；不要与表示“躺”的 lie（lay, lain）混淆。

example.english: The boy lied to the king about the broken net.
example.chinese: 男孩对国王撒谎，说网没有破。

application.prompt: He said something untrue to the king. He ___ to the king. (lied / lay)
application.solution: lied。解析：lie 表示“撒谎”时过去式为 lied。

grammar: 动词，表示假装；常用 pretend to do sth 或 pretend (that) 从句。
collocations: pretend to be asleep；pretend to know；pretend that ...
commonMistake: pretend 后可接 to do；不要用 pretend someone to do 的结构。

example.english: The duckling pretended to be asleep.
example.chinese: 小鸭子假装睡着了。

application.prompt: The child acted as if he were asleep. He ___ to be asleep. (pretended / praised)
application.solution: pretended。解析：假装做某事可用 pretend to do。

grammar: 按课本义作可数名词，表示官员、高级职员；复数为 officials。
collocations: a government official；a school official；an official
commonMistake: official 作名词表示官员；作形容词时可表示官方的，注意词性随语境变化。

example.english: An official read the new rule to the villagers.
example.chinese: 一位官员向村民宣读了新规定。

application.prompt: A person who works in an official position is an ___. (official / hunter)
application.solution: official。解析：官员是 official。

grammar: 形容词，表示愚蠢的、傻的；可作定语或表语。
collocations: a silly mistake；a silly idea；That was silly.
commonMistake: silly 是形容词；不要与副词 silly 混用，副词形式为 foolishly 等。

example.english: It was silly to hide the truth from your friends.
example.chinese: 对朋友隐瞒真相是不明智的。

application.prompt: A careless and foolish idea can be called ___. (silly / suddenly)
application.solution: silly。解析：silly 表示愚蠢的、傻的。

grammar: 动词，表示决定；常用 decide to do sth。
collocations: decide to go；decide what to do；decide on a plan
commonMistake: decide 后表示“决定做某事”常接 to do，不说 decide do。

example.english: They decided to search the forest together.
example.chinese: 他们决定一起搜寻森林。

application.prompt: The children made a choice to go home. They decided ___ home. (to go / go)
application.solution: to go。解析：decide 后接动词不定式。

grammar: 可作动词或名词，表示赞美、表扬；常用 praise sb for sth。
collocations: praise someone for；receive praise；words of praise
commonMistake: 表达因某事表扬某人用 praise sb for sth；不要漏掉 for。

example.english: The king praised the child for telling the truth.
example.chinese: 国王表扬了那个说出真相的孩子。

application.prompt: The teacher said Mia did well and praised her ___ her honesty. (for / at)
application.solution: for。解析：praise sb for sth 表示因某事表扬某人。

grammar: 形容词，表示害怕的、担心的；常用 be afraid of sth 或 be afraid to do sth。
collocations: be afraid of the dark；be afraid to ask；I'm afraid ...
commonMistake: afraid 常与 be 连用；说害怕某物用 afraid of，不说 afraid from。

example.english: The duckling was afraid of the loud noise.
example.chinese: 小鸭子害怕那声巨响。

application.prompt: The child fears the dark. He is afraid ___ it. (of / to)
application.solution: of。解析：害怕某物用 be afraid of sth。

grammar: 副词，表示突然地、出乎意料地；可放在句首或动词前。
collocations: suddenly appear；suddenly stop；Suddenly, ...
commonMistake: suddenly 是副词；对应形容词 sudden，修饰名词时用 sudden。

example.english: Suddenly, the door opened and a swan walked in.
example.chinese: 突然，门开了，一只天鹅走了进来。

application.prompt: The lights went out without warning. ___, the room became dark. (Suddenly / Sillily)
application.solution: Suddenly。解析：表示事情突然发生用 suddenly。

grammar: 副词短语，表示“起初、最初”；常与 later、but 等词形成前后变化。
collocations: at first；at first ... but later ...
commonMistake: at first 表示起初；at the beginning 常指某事物的开头或起点。

example.english: At first, the duckling felt lonely, but later it made friends.
example.chinese: 起初，小鸭子感到孤独，但后来它交到了朋友。

application.prompt: The story was confusing in the beginning, but I understood it later. ___, I did not understand it. (At first / In the end)
application.solution: At first。解析：起初不明白，后来理解，对应 at first。

grammar: 不可数名词，表示真相、事实；常用 the truth，表示“真相”时一般不加 a。
collocations: tell the truth；know the truth；the truth about sth
commonMistake: truth 通常是不可数名词；说“一个真相”时不要直接用 a truth 表达课本义。

example.english: The truth about the missing net surprised everyone.
example.chinese: 网不见的真相让所有人都很惊讶。

application.prompt: Choose the natural expression: “Please tell me ___.” (the truth / a truth)
application.solution: the truth。解析：固定表达为 tell the truth。

grammar: 固定动词短语，表示“说实话”；tell 的过去式和过去分词为 told。
collocations: tell the truth；to tell the truth；tell someone the truth
commonMistake: 固定搭配用 tell the truth，不说 say the truth；tell 的过去式是 told。

example.english: The boy told the truth about the broken basket.
example.chinese: 男孩说出了篮子被弄坏的真相。

application.prompt: Choose the correct verb: “Please ___ the truth.” (tell / say)
application.solution: tell。解析：固定搭配是 tell the truth。

grammar: 动词短语，表示赚钱；money 通常作不可数名词。
collocations: make money；make money by doing sth；make enough money
commonMistake: 表达“赚钱”用 make money；money 前通常不加 a。

example.english: The farmer sells apples to make money.
example.chinese: 农民卖苹果赚钱。

application.prompt: The farmer sells fruit to earn money. He sells fruit to ___. (make money / make a money)
application.solution: make money。解析：money 通常不可数，短语为 make money。

grammar: 形容词，表示符合事实的、真正的；名词形式 truth，副词形式 truly。
collocations: a true story；be true；true to life
commonMistake: true 是形容词，修饰名词；truth 是名词，不要混用。

example.english: The old king learned that the story was true.
example.chinese: 老国王得知这个故事是真的。

application.prompt: Choose the adjective: “Is the story ___?” (true / truth)
application.solution: true。解析：be 动词后作表语要用形容词 true。

grammar: 动词，表示不喜欢、厌恶；后可接名词、动词 -ing 或 to do。hate doing 与 hate to do 都可用。
collocations: hate doing sth；hate a noise；hate to wait
commonMistake: hate 后可接动名词或不定式；不要直接接动词原形，如 hate wait。

example.english: The duckling hated being alone.
example.chinese: 小鸭子不喜欢独自待着。

application.prompt: Complete the sentence: “I hate ___ for a long time.” (waiting / wait)
application.solution: waiting。解析：hate 后可接动词 -ing 形式。

grammar: 短语动词，可表示“离开、逃脱”；常用 get out of a place。
collocations: get out of the room；get out safely；get out of the car
commonMistake: get out 单独使用可表示离开；指出离开某个空间时常说 get out of it/the room。

example.english: The duckling got out of the net and ran to the lake.
example.chinese: 小鸭子从网里逃了出来，跑向湖边。

application.prompt: The bird escaped from the cage. It managed to ___. (get out / go away at)
application.solution: get out。解析：逃出某处可说 get out。

grammar: 可数名词，表示国王；复数为 kings；特指故事中的国王时常用 the king。
collocations: a wise king；the king's palace；king and queen
commonMistake: 表示泛指的一位国王用 a king；特指故事中已提到的人物用 the king。

example.english: The king listened carefully to the young hunter.
example.chinese: 国王认真地听年轻猎人讲述。

application.prompt: The ruler of a kingdom is a ___. (king / artist)
application.solution: king。解析：王国的统治者是 king。

grammar: 可数名词，表示美术家、艺术家；复数为 artists。
collocations: a famous artist；an artist paints；artist's work
commonMistake: artist 指艺术家；art 是艺术，artistic 是形容词“艺术的”。

example.english: The artist painted a picture of the white swan.
example.chinese: 这位艺术家画了一幅白天鹅的画。

application.prompt: A person who makes paintings is an ___. (artist / emperor)
application.solution: artist。解析：画家、艺术家是 artist。

grammar: 副词，表示快速地；由形容词 quick 加 -ly 构成，常修饰动作。
collocations: run quickly；answer quickly；move quickly
commonMistake: quickly 是副词；修饰名词用形容词 quick。

example.english: The hunter quickly closed the gate.
example.chinese: 猎人迅速地关上了大门。

application.prompt: The boy ran ___ to catch the bus. (quickly / quick)
application.solution: quickly。解析：修饰动词 ran 要用副词。

grammar: 可作动词或名词，表示微笑；常用 smile at sb。
collocations: smile at someone；give a smile；a warm smile
commonMistake: smile 通常不直接接人作宾语；说对某人微笑用 smile at sb。

example.english: The duckling smiled at the farmer.
example.chinese: 小鸭子对农夫微笑。

application.prompt: She saw her friend and smiled ___ him. (at / to)
application.solution: at。解析：对某人微笑用 smile at sb。

grammar: 副词短语，表示“到处、遍及”；常与地点名词搭配，如 all over the world。
collocations: all over the village；all over the world；search all over
commonMistake: all over 表示遍及某范围；地点名词前通常保留 the，如 all over the village。

example.english: The news spread all over the village.
example.chinese: 消息传遍了整个村庄。

application.prompt: The story became known everywhere in the village. It spread ___. (all over the village / at first)
application.solution: all over the village。解析：表示遍及整个村庄用 all over the village。

grammar: 形容词，表示丑陋的、难看的；可作定语或表语。
collocations: an ugly duckling；an ugly building；look ugly
commonMistake: ugly 是形容词；以辅音音素开头，单数名词前用 an。

example.english: The little duckling thought it was ugly.
example.chinese: 小鸭子觉得自己很难看。

application.prompt: Choose the correct article: “___ ugly duckling” (a / an)
application.solution: an。解析：ugly 以元音音素开头，前用 an。

grammar: 可数名词，表示小鸭子；复数为 ducklings。
collocations: a little duckling；a mother duck and her ducklings
commonMistake: duckling 表示小鸭子；表示一只时用 a duckling。

example.english: The duckling followed its mother across the grass.
example.chinese: 小鸭子跟着妈妈穿过草地。

application.prompt: A young duck is a ___. (duckling / swan)
application.solution: duckling。解析：小鸭子是 duckling。

grammar: 形容词，表示真的、真正的；副词形式为 really。
collocations: a real story；a real friend；real life
commonMistake: real 是形容词，修饰名词；really 是副词，可修饰形容词或动词。

example.english: The farmer found a real feather beside the lake.
example.chinese: 农夫在湖边找到了一根真的羽毛。

application.prompt: Choose the adjective: “This is a ___ swan.” (real / really)
application.solution: real。解析：修饰名词 swan 要用形容词 real。

grammar: 动词短语，表示嘲笑；at 后接被嘲笑的人或事。
collocations: laugh at a mistake；laugh at someone；Don't laugh at ...
commonMistake: laugh at someone 表示嘲笑某人；注意 laugh 是笑，laugh at 带有取笑的意思。

example.english: Good friends do not laugh at one another's mistakes.
example.chinese: 好朋友不会嘲笑彼此的错误。

application.prompt: Don't ___ classmates for their mistakes. (laugh at / look after)
application.solution: laugh at。解析：题干要求“嘲笑”，对应 laugh at。

grammar: 短语动词，表示走开、离开；一般过去式为 went away。
collocations: go away；go away from the door；ask someone to go away
commonMistake: go away 的过去式是 went away；表示离开某地也可说 go away from ...。

example.english: The hunter went away before the swan returned.
example.chinese: 猎人离开后，天鹅才回来。

application.prompt: Yesterday the visitor left. He ___ before dinner. (went away / go away)
application.solution: went away。解析：过去时间 yesterday 对应 went away。

grammar: 动词，表示搜寻；可直接接被搜查的地点或对象，如 search the room。
collocations: search a room；search someone's bag；search the forest
commonMistake: search a place 表示搜查该地点；search for sth 表示寻找某物，注意搭配不同。

example.english: The children searched the garden for the missing feather.
example.chinese: 孩子们在花园里搜寻那根丢失的羽毛。

application.prompt: They checked every part of the room. They ___ the room. (searched / searched for)
application.solution: searched。解析：直接搜查某个地点用 search + 地点。

grammar: 动词短语，表示寻找某人或某物；for 后接寻找的目标。
collocations: search for a key；search for the duckling；search for information
commonMistake: search for sth 表示寻找目标；若宾语是被搜查的地点，可用 search + 地点。

example.english: The farmer searched for the duckling near the lake.
example.chinese: 农夫在湖边寻找小鸭子。

application.prompt: The farmer is trying to find his lost net. He is searching ___ it. (for / at)
application.solution: for。解析：search for sth 表示寻找某物。

grammar: 可数名词，表示母鸡；复数为 hens。
collocations: a hen and her chicks；a hen lays eggs
commonMistake: hen 指母鸡；泛指鸡这种动物可用 chicken。

example.english: A hen laid an egg in the straw.
example.chinese: 一只母鸡在稻草里下了一个蛋。

application.prompt: A female chicken is a ___. (hen / rooster)
application.solution: hen。解析：母鸡是 hen。

grammar: 副词，表示有希望地、满怀希望地；由 hopeful 加 -ly 构成。
collocations: wait hopefully；look hopefully；Hopefully, ...
commonMistake: hopefully 是副词；hopeful 是形容词，常用 be hopeful。

example.english: Hopefully, the lost duckling will come home soon.
example.chinese: 希望那只走失的小鸭子很快就会回家。

application.prompt: The family hopes for good news. They wait ___. (hopefully / hopeful)
application.solution: hopefully。解析：修饰 wait 的动作需要副词。

grammar: 可作动词或名词，表示猫愉快时发出的呜呜声；动词第三人称单数为 purrs。
collocations: a cat purrs；purr softly；hear a purr
commonMistake: purr 常指猫发出的满足声；不要与狗叫 bark 混淆。

example.english: The cat purred softly beside the warm fire.
example.chinese: 猫在温暖的炉火旁轻轻地发出呜呜声。

application.prompt: A happy cat makes a low, soft sound. It may ___. (purr / shout)
application.solution: purr。解析：猫满足时发出的呜呜声是 purr。

examTags: 语法·过去式与过去分词
grammar: 动词，表示下蛋、放置；过去式和过去分词均为 laid。
collocations: lay an egg；lay a book on the desk；laid an egg
commonMistake: lay 的过去式是 laid；lie 表示“撒谎”时过去式是 lied，注意区别。

example.english: The hen laid an egg before sunrise.
example.chinese: 母鸡在日出前下了一个蛋。

application.prompt: Yesterday the hen ___ an egg. (laid / layed)
application.solution: laid。解析：lay 的过去式为 laid。

grammar: 可数名词，表示天鹅；复数为 swans。
collocations: a white swan；a swan on the lake；swans swim
commonMistake: swan 是可数名词；单数前加 a/an，复数形式直接加 -s。

example.english: A white swan swam across the lake.
example.chinese: 一只白天鹅游过了湖面。

application.prompt: A large white water bird is a ___. (swan / hen)
application.solution: swan。解析：天鹅是 swan。

grammar: 可数名词，表示羽毛；复数为 feathers。
collocations: a soft feather；bird feathers；a feather from a swan
commonMistake: feather 是可数名词；表示一根羽毛时用 a feather。

example.english: The girl picked up a grey feather by the path.
example.chinese: 女孩在小路边捡起一根灰色的羽毛。

application.prompt: One piece of a bird's covering is a ___. (feather / net)
application.solution: feather。解析：鸟的羽毛是 feather。

grammar: 固定表达，意为“令某人惊讶的是”；sb’s 位置要换成具体的所有格形式，如 to our surprise。
collocations: to my surprise；to everyone's surprise；much to her surprise
commonMistake: 实际使用时把 sb’s 换成 my、his、our 等所有格形式；不要把 sb 当成句子里的单词。

example.english: To our surprise, the small duckling grew into a beautiful swan.
example.chinese: 令我们惊讶的是，那只小鸭子长成了一只美丽的天鹅。

application.prompt: Choose the phrase meaning 令我们惊讶的是: ___. (To our surprise / At first)
application.solution: To our surprise。解析：表示“令我们惊讶的是”用 to our surprise。

grammar: 可数名词，表示大小、尺寸；常用 What size ...? 询问尺寸。
collocations: What size is it?；a different size；the size of a room
commonMistake: 询问尺寸用 What size ...?；不要说 How size ...?。

example.english: What size is your new jacket?
example.chinese: 你的新夹克是什么尺码？

application.prompt: Ask about the size of a jacket: “___ is your jacket?”
application.solution: What size。解析：询问尺寸用 What size ...?。

grammar: 动词，表示相信、认为；可接名词、that 从句或 believe in。
collocations: believe a story；believe someone；believe in yourself
commonMistake: believe sb 表示相信某人说的话；believe in sb 表示信任、相信某人的能力或价值。

example.english: I believe the fisherman because he told the truth.
example.chinese: 我相信渔夫，因为他说了实话。

application.prompt: You trust that your friend is telling the truth. You ___ your friend. (believe / praise)
application.solution: believe。解析：相信某人说的话用 believe sb。

grammar: 连词短语，表示“只有在……条件下”；if 引导条件内容。
collocations: only if you agree；only if it is safe；only if ...
commonMistake: only if 表示必要条件；不要与 even if（即使）混淆。

example.english: You may feed the swans only if an adult is with you.
example.chinese: 只有在有成年人陪同的情况下，你才可以喂天鹅。

application.prompt: Visitors may enter only when the guide agrees; if the guide does not agree, they must stay outside. Visitors may enter ___ the guide agrees. (only if / even if)
application.solution: only if。解析：进入的必要条件是导游同意，应用 only if。

grammar: 可数名词，表示渔夫；复数为 fishermen。
collocations: a fisherman；fishermen at work；a fisherman's net
commonMistake: fisherman 的复数是 fishermen，man 变为 men。

example.english: The fisherman pulled his net out of the water.
example.chinese: 渔夫把网从水里拉了出来。

application.prompt: One fisherman, two ___. (fishermen / fishermans)
application.solution: fishermen。解析：fisherman 的复数形式为 fishermen。

grammar: 名词，表示钓鱼、捕鱼；常用 go fishing 表示去钓鱼。
collocations: go fishing；enjoy fishing；fishing boat
commonMistake: 表示去钓鱼用 go fishing，不说 go to fishing。

example.english: My uncle enjoys fishing by the lake on Sundays.
example.chinese: 我叔叔喜欢星期天在湖边钓鱼。

application.prompt: They are going to catch fish for fun. They are going ___. (fishing / to fishing)
application.solution: fishing。解析：表示去钓鱼用 go fishing。

grammar: 短语动词，可表示出现、显现；come 的过去式是 came，过去分词是 come。
collocations: the sun comes out；flowers come out；come out of the room
commonMistake: come out 的过去式是 came out；come out of 表示从……出来。

example.english: The moon came out after the clouds moved away.
example.chinese: 云散开后，月亮出来了。

application.prompt: The stars appeared last night. The stars ___ after dark. (came out / come out)
application.solution: came out。解析：last night 表示过去，come 的过去式是 came。

grammar: 可数名词，表示妖怪、精灵；复数为 genies。
collocations: a genie in a lamp；a magic genie；genies
commonMistake: genie 是童话中的精灵，不等同于一般的 ghost（鬼魂）。

example.english: A genie came out of the old lamp.
example.chinese: 一个精灵从旧灯里出现了。

application.prompt: In the story, a magical being comes from a lamp. It is a ___. (genie / official)
application.solution: genie。解析：灯中出现的魔法精灵是 genie。

grammar: 动词，表示死亡、消失；过去式和过去分词为 died；形容词为 dead，名词为 death。
collocations: die of an illness；die in a fire；plants die
commonMistake: die 是动词，dead 是形容词，death 是名词；不要混用词性。

example.english: The small plant died because it had no water.
example.chinese: 小植物因为没有水而枯死了。

application.prompt: The plant is no longer alive; it is ___. (dead / die)
application.solution: dead。解析：be 动词后作表语用形容词 dead。

grammar: 动词短语，表示“许下承诺”；常用 make a promise to sb 或 make a promise to do sth。
collocations: make a promise；keep a promise；break a promise
commonMistake: 许诺说 make a promise；遵守承诺用 keep a promise，违背承诺用 break a promise。

example.english: The prince made a promise to return the feather.
example.chinese: 王子答应把羽毛送回来。

application.prompt: She said she would help and ___ to her friend. (made a promise / told a truth)
application.solution: made a promise。解析：许下承诺用 make a promise。

grammar: 不定代词，表示某人、有人；通常作单数看待，后接单数谓语。
collocations: someone is；someone's name；someone else
commonMistake: someone 作主语时谓语通常用单数，如 Someone is here.。

example.english: Someone left a feather beside the gate.
example.chinese: 有人把一根羽毛落在了大门旁边。

application.prompt: ___ is waiting outside the classroom. (Someone / Some people)
application.solution: Someone。解析：谓语 is 对应单数不定代词 someone。

grammar: 动词，按课本义可表示“使处于某种状况；使开始”；现在式、过去式和过去分词均为 set。
collocations: set something moving；set a plan in motion；set ... free
commonMistake: set 的过去式和过去分词仍是 set；注意按语境辨认其多种含义。

example.english: The loud noise set the birds flying.
example.chinese: 巨大的响声惊得鸟儿飞了起来。

application.prompt: Yesterday the noise ___ the birds flying. (set / setted)
application.solution: set。解析：set 的过去式仍为 set。

grammar: 动词短语，表示释放；常用 set + 宾语 + free。
collocations: set a bird free；set someone free；set the swan free
commonMistake: 最常见语序是 set the bird free；宾语放在 set 与 free 之间。

example.english: The children set the trapped swan free.
example.chinese: 孩子们放走了被困的天鹅。

application.prompt: They released the bird. They ___ the bird ___. (set, free / put, free)
application.solution: set, free。解析：释放某人或动物可说 set sb/sth free。

grammar: 形容词，表示富有的；也可表示“富含……的”，常用 rich in。
collocations: a rich king；be rich in history；rich in vitamins
commonMistake: rich 是形容词；表示富含某物常用 rich in，不说 rich of。

example.english: The rich king gave food to the hungry villagers.
example.chinese: 富有的国王把食物分给了饥饿的村民。

application.prompt: This food has a lot of vitamins. It is rich ___ vitamins. (in / at)
application.solution: in。解析：表示富含某物用 rich in。

grammar: 形容词，表示强大的、有影响力的；由 power 加后缀 -ful 构成。
collocations: a powerful king；a powerful voice；a powerful storm
commonMistake: powerful 是形容词；名词为 power，副词为 powerfully。

example.english: A powerful wind blew the leaves across the road.
example.chinese: 一阵强风把树叶吹过了马路。

application.prompt: A storm with great strength is a ___ storm. (powerful / power)
application.solution: powerful。解析：修饰名词 storm 需要形容词 powerful。

examTags: 语法·疑问句与主谓一致
grammar: 不定代词，表示任何人、某个人；常见于疑问句和否定句，通常作单数看待。
collocations: Does anyone know?；anyone else；not anyone
commonMistake: anyone 作主语时通常搭配单数谓语；肯定句中表示“有人”常用 someone。

example.english: Did anyone see the swan near the lake?
example.chinese: 有人看见湖边的天鹅了吗？

application.prompt: ___ is welcome to join the story club. (Anyone / Any people)
application.solution: Anyone。解析：anyone 是单数不定代词，表示任何人。

grammar: 介词短语，表示“而不是、代替”；of 后接名词、代词或动词 -ing 形式。
collocations: instead of tea；instead of walking；instead of him
commonMistake: instead of 中 of 是介词，后接名词或动名词；不要说 instead of to walk。

example.english: The boy read a story instead of watching television.
example.chinese: 男孩读了故事，而不是看电视。

application.prompt: Choose the correct form: “She went by bus instead of ___.” (walking / walk)
application.solution: walking。解析：介词 of 后接动名词。

grammar: 固定结构，表示“成功做成某事”；in 是介词，后接动词 -ing 形式。
collocations: succeed in finding sth；succeed in doing sth；success
commonMistake: succeed in 后接动名词，不说 succeed to do；名词 success 与动词 succeed 注意词形。

example.english: The fisherman succeeded in finding his lost net.
example.chinese: 渔夫成功找到了丢失的网。

application.prompt: Choose the correct form: “They succeeded in ___ the swan.” (saving / save)
application.solution: saving。解析：succeed in 中 in 是介词，后接动名词。

grammar: 反身代词，表示“他自己”；可作宾语或用于强调，指代男性单数主语。
collocations: by himself；help himself；the king himself
commonMistake: himself 是反身代词；一般作宾语用 him，不能把 himself 用来替代所有 him。

example.english: The king himself opened the gate.
example.chinese: 国王亲自打开了大门。

application.prompt: The king did it, not another person. The king did it ___. (himself / him)
application.solution: himself。解析：强调国王亲自做，用反身代词 himself。

grammar: 副词短语，表示“最后、终究”，常指经历一段时间或过程后的结果。
collocations: in the end；win in the end；in the end, ...
commonMistake: in the end 表示最终结果；at the end (of sth) 指某事物的末尾或终点。

example.english: They searched all day and found the duckling in the end.
example.chinese: 他们搜寻了一整天，最终找到了小鸭子。

application.prompt: After a long search, they finally found the key. ___, they opened the gate. (In the end / At first)
application.solution: In the end。解析：经过过程后得到最终结果用 in the end。

grammar: 丹麦作家汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生的英文姓名；各部分首字母大写。
collocations: Hans Christian Andersen；Andersen's fairy tales；a story by Andersen
commonMistake: 人名各部分首字母大写；Andersen 是姓氏，不要将姓名词序颠倒。

example.english: Hans Christian Andersen wrote many well-known fairy tales.
example.chinese: 汉斯·克里斯蒂安·安徒生创作了许多著名童话。

application.prompt: Choose the correctly written author's name: (Hans Christian Andersen / hans christian andersen)
application.solution: Hans Christian Andersen。解析：专有姓名各部分首字母大写。
